scope: adds CPU identity/range to the existing development-mechanism comparison; not a new independent case analysis
shared: common contract evaluator and external review ledger

new_mechanism.name: CPU identity namespace, count/bound/activation limits and preparation coverage
new_mechanism.relation: selected logical identities are not invented, count respects nr_cpus, no silent replacement without truncation, and every CPU brought online already has its preparation objects (IRQ stacks, per-CPU offsets)
new_mechanism.specialized_facts: namespace/mapping adapter, staged possible/present/online snapshots, nr_cpu_ids at each stage, cpumask width branch from .i and object relocations, actual guest registers for mapped CPUs
explicit_applicability_conditions: selection count vs later bound vs activation limit
setter assigning vs FORCE warning branch

cannot_borrow_from.CPU topology preparation: topology set coverage of a target CPU does not establish that the CPU's own identity was selected or prepared
cannot_borrow_from.CPU source-qualified export: compiled/linked publication of attributes says nothing about which logical IDs are possible
cannot_borrow_from.virtio DMA buffer: a geometric/alignment check is not a set-membership/preparation check
cannot_borrow_from.Btrfs geometry: numeric clipping equality is not identity preservation

open: first hard IRQ / first per-CPU use

cross_mechanism_observation: configuration-dependent width/branch selection (cpumask width, FORCE_NR_CPUS) recurs as an applicability condition, analogous to version-dependent policy in source export and coherency/backend branch in virtio; it must be bound per concrete configuration, not inferred from a reduced projection
manual: object-pattern rules (revised once for loop rotation)
